legend.PARTIAL: Real capability shipped with explicit boundaries
legend.BLOCKED: Capability defined but data/infrastructure not available
legend.MISSING: Not built; requires data or infrastructure that does not exist yet

capabilities.capability: Company research workspace (recorded evidence, financials, intel)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Generic news feeds do not bind every statement to provenance and availability timestamps.
capabilities.data_dependency: Recorded fixture archive per company (market CSV, financials JSON, intel JSON, sources JSON).
capabilities.pit_requirement: Every item filtered to available_at <= as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Every evidence record carries source_ids + provenance_ids.

capabilities.capability: Discovery feed + trending
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Feeds ordered by timestamp/id determinism instead of engagement heuristics.
capabilities.data_dependency: Recorded intel across the 6-company universe.
capabilities.pit_requirement: as_of cutoff honored.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Items reference source ids.

capabilities.capability: Advanced screener (39 real fields, 17 categories, 12 operators)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Most retail screeners hide missing data as zeros; here 'missing' is an explicit first-class query.
capabilities.data_dependency: FIELD_REGISTRY over recorded financial periods.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Field extraction at explicit as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Fields trace to financial records in the archive.

capabilities.capability: Evidence search 2.0 (AND terms, exact phrase, match tier labels, snippets, published/observation windows, historical mode)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Search results expose WHERE terms matched (title/text/metadata) as categorical labels, never opaque relevance scores.
capabilities.data_dependency: Canonical evidence lineage per company.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Historical search returns only provably-knowable items (available_at <= as_of).
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Hits carry source_ids + provenance_ids + claim ids.

capabilities.capability: Research Change Radar 2.0 (typed transitions for evidence, financials, events, gaps, sources, screen membership)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Competitors show a static snapshot; none offer auditable diffs of the research record itself with before/after/why_changed fields.
capabilities.data_dependency: Two recorded runs at distinct as_of timestamps.
capabilities.pit_requirement: baseline_as_of < current_as_of enforced; effective_at never exceeds current as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each change references source + provenance ids where applicable.

capabilities.capability: Evidence Delta 2.0 (new/removed/changed evidence, conflict transitions, gap transitions, freshness changes, removed observations)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor surfaces how the evidence base itself moved between dates, including removed observations.
capabilities.data_dependency: Same as Change Radar.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Both sides computed at their own as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Delta entries carry full lineage ids.

capabilities.capability: Research Context Snapshot 2.0 (deterministic replay, PIT accounting, provenance summary)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Analysts cannot today share a link that deterministically reproduces one research state with full provenance context.
capabilities.data_dependency: Deterministic id derivation from symbol + as_of.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Replay re-runs the recorded service at the embedded as_of; tampered ids rejected via digest check.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Snapshot embeds PIT accounting identical to /research contract.

capabilities.capability: Conflict Explorer 2.0 (both sides, status classification, source priority rules, no silent resolution)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Competitors silently pick a narrative; this system names both sides, classifies conflict status (OPEN/RESOLVED/PARTIAL), and exposes source priority rules without auto-resolution.
capabilities.data_dependency: Conflict detection over intel items sharing a topic with opposing directions.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Conflicts evaluated at as_of only from known items.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each side cites its own source, excerpt, provenance, and as_of.

capabilities.capability: Coverage Delta 2.0 (category transitions, gap opened/resolved, source freshness changes)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Coverage changes are invisible elsewhere; here they are first-class transitions with explicit direction labels.
capabilities.data_dependency: Coverage status per run.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Both sides at their own as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Gap transitions reference gap ids.

capabilities.capability: Compare 2.0 (side-by-side facts, per-company coverage/conflict summaries, provenance per cell)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Comparisons state facts without ratings and disclose when columns were captured at different times.
capabilities.data_dependency: >=2 recorded runs.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Notes flag any column whose captured as_of differs.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Rows derive from recorded artifacts only.

capabilities.capability: Recorded-event calendar 2.0 (RECORDED vs ANNOUNCED, effective_date, available_at, explicit non-guarantee)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Event calendars elsewhere imply certainty; announced items are labeled as non-guaranteed statements of intent.
capabilities.data_dependency: Timeline entries in the recorded intel archive.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Range filtering on event_date; ANNOUNCED = future-dated relative to as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Events carry source + provenance ids.

capabilities.capability: Export package 2.0 (research.json + evidence.json + pit.json + sources.csv + coverage.json + manifest.json)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Exports are verifiable byte-for-byte and carry the PIT accounting block plus schema version.
capabilities.data_dependency: All payloads already produced by engines.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Package stamped with result.as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Manifest checksums make tampering detectable.

capabilities.capability: Research Change Graph (deterministic relationship metadata between changes: related_to, occurred_alongside, recorded_in_same_context)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor exposes how research changes relate to each other; this system builds a deterministic relationship graph with safe vocabulary only (no causal language).
capabilities.data_dependency: Research changes from Change Radar.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Relationships computed from PIT-safe change records.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Relationships reference evidence_ids, source_ids, provenance_ids from the source changes.

capabilities.capability: Research Test Graph (evidence requirement inventory for 13 research tests with NOT_EVALUABLE/PARTIALLY_EVALUATED states)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor inventories which research tests can be evaluated vs which are blocked by missing evidence. Tests are never deleted when evidence is missing.
capabilities.data_dependency: Evidence items, intel items, financial periods, source statuses, gaps, conflicts.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Tests evaluated at explicit as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Test results reference available evidence and source ids.

capabilities.capability: Source Intelligence (deterministic source states: CURRENT/STALE/MISSING/DEGRADED/UNKNOWN with freshness, evidence count, PIT eligibility)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor exposes deterministic source states with evidence counts and PIT eligibility without converting to scores.
capabilities.data_dependency: Source statuses and evidence items.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Source states evaluated at as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each source references its evidence items.

capabilities.capability: Historical Research Replay (context A, context B, delta with replay metadata, PIT enforcement verification)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor supports deterministic replay of two historical research contexts with full PIT verification and delta computation.
capabilities.data_dependency: Recorded verification results at distinct as_of timestamps.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Replay preserves PIT: 2024 context cannot see 2025 evidence. Same context replay produces identical output.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Replay metadata includes schema_version, context_id, created_from_as_of, replayed_as_of, source_snapshot_state.

capabilities.capability: Financial Quality (REPORTED/DERIVED observations for revenue, margins, returns, cash conversion with derivation formulas)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor distinguishes reported from derived financial observations or exposes derivation formulas for every derived metric.
capabilities.data_dependency: Financial periods with metrics.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Observations from PIT-filtered financial periods.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each observation references source and provenance ids.

capabilities.capability: Business/Tech Evidence Depth (10 evidence dimensions with STRONG/PARTIAL/WEAK/MISSING epistemic classification)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor classifies business/technology evidence by epistemic state or explicitly catalogues weak/missing areas.
capabilities.data_dependency: Intel items with categories, sources, and timestamps.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Evidence evaluated at as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each observation references source and provenance ids.

capabilities.capability: Ownership Audit (deterministic assessment of ownership data availability with BLOCKED/PARTIAL status and reasons)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: System explicitly records that no ownership fixtures exist rather than returning empty or fabricated data.
capabilities.data_dependency: No recorded ownership fixtures. Yahoo Finance ownership fetched live, not from fixtures.
capabilities.pit_requirement: N/A — no fixture data available.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: N/A — no fixture data available.
capabilities.next_dependency: Recorded ownership fixtures or bulk/block deal data

capabilities.capability: Alert Event Contract (9 event types with alert_type, symbol, change_id, context_id, source_ids, provenance_ids, summary)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor defines a deterministic, backend-neutral alert event contract separate from delivery infrastructure.
capabilities.data_dependency: Research changes from Change Radar.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Alert events derived from PIT-safe change records.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Events reference source_ids and provenance_ids from source changes.
capabilities.next_dependency: Delivery system, auth, database, email, webhook (future sprint)

capabilities.capability: Canonical Research Snapshot (consolidated research product with identity, changes, observations, evidence, coverage, conflicts, gaps, freshness, sources, provenance)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor consolidates all research outputs into a single deterministic snapshot contract with section-level evidence counts and PIT accounting.
capabilities.data_dependency: All research engines producing evidence, conflicts, gaps, sources, provenance.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Snapshot built at explicit as_of; identity carries PIT accounting from verification result.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Every observation, evidence, source, and conflict carries source_ids + provenance_ids.

capabilities.capability: Research Section Registry (9 canonical sections with availability status, evidence counts, freshness, staleness)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor exposes a section-level registry with deterministic availability status and evidence counts per research area.
capabilities.data_dependency: All research engines producing section-level data.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Registry computed at explicit as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each section entry carries evidence_ids and source_ids.

capabilities.capability: Canonical Research Observation (frozen Pydantic model with identification, metric/domain, period, value/unit, direction, epistemic, verification, temporal, source/provenance, derivation, limitations)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor provides a canonical observation model that forbids scores while preserving full provenance lineage and epistemic classification.
capabilities.data_dependency: Financial quality, business/tech evidence, and other observation-producing engines.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Observations carry temporal (observation_at, available_at) fields for PIT filtering.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each observation carries source_ids, provenance_ids, derivation chain, and limitations.

capabilities.capability: Canonical Research Vocabulary (12 enums covering availability, test state, epistemic type/strength, source freshness, conflict resolution, gap status, direction, severity, observation origin, verification status, section status, ownership capability)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor defines a canonical vocabulary shared across all research modules with no causal language and explicit schema versioning.
capabilities.data_dependency: All research modules using vocabulary enums.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Vocabulary is stateless; schema version tracks vocabulary evolution.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: N/A — vocabulary defines enum values, not data lineage.

capabilities.capability: Ownership analysis (promoter/institutional/public/pledge, trends, signals)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Ownership trends and signals are derived from Yahoo Finance snapshots.
capabilities.data_dependency: Yahoo Finance ownership snapshots. No bulk/block deal recordings in fixtures.
capabilities.pit_requirement: as_of cutoff honored for snapshot selection.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Snapshots reference Yahoo Finance source.

capabilities.capability: Change timeline UI (visual timeline of research changes)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: API contract exists; frontend rendering is Terminal 2 scope.
capabilities.data_dependency: Same as Change Radar.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Inherited.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Inherited.

capabilities.capability: Point-in-time replay sessions (browse any historical date interactively)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Full two-context replay with delta and PIT verification; single-state reproducibility proven.
capabilities.data_dependency: Recorded fixtures per company.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Replay enforces PIT; tampered context ids rejected.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Replay metadata includes schema_version, context_id, source_snapshot_state.

capabilities.capability: Provenance chain drill-down (source -> acquisition -> transformation -> artifact)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Source/provenance ids exposed everywhere; deep chain visualization pending frontend work.
capabilities.data_dependency: Raw archive records tracked in git.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Inherited.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: This IS the provenance capability.

capabilities.capability: Research memory (persisted analyst notes bound to context ids)
capabilities.data_dependency: Requires user-scoped storage; no auth/user model exists yet.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Must store context_id, never mutable snapshots.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Notes must link back to replayable contexts.

capabilities.capability: Live market/news ingestion for change detection in production
capabilities.data_dependency: Requires production archiving pipeline; beta runs on committed fixtures.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Availability timestamps must be assigned at ingestion time.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Raw records must land before derived artifacts.

capabilities.capability: Multi-asset coverage (ETF/MF/IPO/F&O/crypto)
capabilities.data_dependency: No real recorded datasets exist for these classes yet.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Same standards apply when real data arrives.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Same.

capabilities.capability: Scores, rankings, buy/sell recommendations, price predictions
capabilities.data_dependency: None — excluded by design.
capabilities.pit_requirement: N/A
capabilities.provenance_requirement: N/A

capabilities.capability: Historical Research Depth Audit (descriptive coverage facts across 9 domains: financials, business, technology, events, risk, market, sources, evidence, ownership)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor exposes descriptive historical depth facts across all research domains with period counts, date ranges, and evidence/source/gap counts.
capabilities.data_dependency: All research engines producing domain-level data.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Depth computed at explicit as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Domain counts derived from PIT-filtered data.

capabilities.capability: Cross-Domain Research Links (deterministic linkage across financial, business, technology, risk, market domains using safe vocabulary: RELATED, SAME_CONTEXT, OCCURRED_ALONGSIDE, TEMPORALLY_ADJACENT)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor exposes deterministic cross-domain relationships with safe vocabulary only and no causal language.
capabilities.data_dependency: Intel items across all domains with shared identifiers, dates, and context.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Links computed at explicit as_of from PIT-filtered items.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each link exposes source_item_id, target_item_id, evidence_ids, and dates.

capabilities.capability: Research Test Execution (evaluates 13 research tests against actual recorded data with EVALUATED/PARTIALLY_EVALUATED/NOT_EVALUABLE/BLOCKED/NOT_APPLICABLE states)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor evaluates which research tests can be run against actual recorded data with explicit required/available/missing evidence breakdown.
capabilities.data_dependency: All research engines producing evidence and gap data.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Tests evaluated at explicit as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each test execution references provenance IDs.

capabilities.capability: Research Gap Depth (gap audit with category counts, status counts, gap grouping for same logical issues across periods, present/absent category tracking)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor groups research gaps by logical issue across periods or tracks which gap categories are present vs absent.
capabilities.data_dependency: Research gap engine.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Gaps evaluated at explicit as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Gaps trace to specific data sources.

capabilities.capability: Source Coverage Intelligence (descriptive source information: source type, evidence count, freshness state, PIT eligibility, provenance completeness, covered domains)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor exposes descriptive source coverage with freshness states and domain mapping without scoring or ranking.
capabilities.data_dependency: Source statuses from research engines.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Source states evaluated at as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each source entry exposes provenance completeness.

capabilities.capability: Evidence Quality Audit (contract validity checks: missing source, missing provenance, missing timestamp, missing direction, zero confidence with deterministic issue detection)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor audits evidence records for contract validity with deterministic issue detection per evidence item.
capabilities.data_dependency: Evidence items from research synthesis.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Evidence audited at explicit as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Issues reference specific evidence IDs.

capabilities.capability: Financial Research Depth (metric-level audit: reported/derived/unavailable counts, units explicit, derivation text, period coverage, no division-by-zero)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor audits financial observations at metric level ensuring reported stays reported, derived stays derived, units explicit, missing stays null.
capabilities.data_dependency: Deep financial insights from financial engine.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Financial observations at explicit as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Financial observations reference available_at timestamps.

capabilities.capability: Business/Tech Evidence Depth (11-domain coverage audit with STRONG/PARTIAL/WEAK/MISSING depth classification across business model, customers, management, competitive, technology, AI, cloud, platforms, R&D, innovation)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor classifies business/technology evidence depth across 11 specific domains with deterministic keyword matching.
capabilities.data_dependency: Intel items across business and technology domains.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Evidence evaluated at as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Domain depth references source and evidence IDs.

capabilities.capability: Change History Quality (audit of change records for completeness: change_id, type, before/after, timestamps, source/provenance IDs with deterministic issue detection)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor audits change records for completeness of required fields with deterministic issue detection.
capabilities.data_dependency: Change records from Change Radar.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Changes evaluated at as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Issues reference specific change IDs.

capabilities.capability: Research Context Reproducibility (verified deterministic replay: same context → same output, same as_of → same evidence/gaps/sources/test state, no future information leaks backward)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor verifies deterministic reproducibility of research context across multiple dimensions with regression tests.
capabilities.data_dependency: Recorded verification results at distinct as_of timestamps.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Replay preserves PIT: earlier context cannot see later evidence.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Replay metadata includes context_id, created_from_as_of, source_snapshot_state.
